Open thread • Replies: 9 • Updated: 2026-11-19 07:42 UTC

OP

Ethereum (ETH) has the potential to be one of the biggest disruptors of traditional finance.

DeFi is a game changer. Imagine lending, borrowing, and earning yield without banks or middlemen.

Banks and financial institutions make billions by facilitating these transactions and collecting fees. Ethereum enables many of these functions through smart contracts, with validators earning transaction fees for securing the network.

The technology is here. The use cases are real. The potential is massive.

So why hasn't Ethereum seen widespread mainstream adoption?
